description:
Resolve the agreed remaining review points 2–5 on https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/pull/847. This is a detailed execution contract, not permission to start coding or publish. User requested creation of this epic after settling each point.

Baseline: ZAQ feat/whatsapp-main at 06bb1c614886e8d031fd6bf509bb620fc7dbaadf; ../jido_chat at eeaebf8 (two shared-contract commits f154f07 and eeaebf8); ../jido_chat_whatsapp at dfa920e. Reverify at execution. Point 1 full-diff Action reuse assessment is already in PR description. Point 6 supervision correction already exists as uncommitted docs/architecture.md change; preserve it. Do not duplicate completed points or broaden into issue #22 scope clarification.

Approved decisions, user source in this conversation (2026-10-21):
- Point 2: user "okay agree" after normalized-only Engine contract and specific fixture/test changes were explained, with requirement to retain WhatsApp phone and name after QR scan. Adapter supplies phone as account.external_id and optional display_name; name absence falls back to phone. Engine owns generic persistence, not WhatsApp identity interpretation. Approved existing-test changes are normalization of legacy fixtures and replacing Engine phone-format expectations with normalized-input/legacy-rejection checks while preserving provider validation at adapter boundary.
- Point 4: user "okay so this should be fixed to super-admin 4 and 5 are clear now" after being shown that the existing LiveView test permits non-super-admin enablement. WhatsApp enable now requires current super-admin in Engine, not only QR gating. Approved test change is non-super-admin enable -> remains disabled/no runtime/no QR. Other providers' permissions are outside scope.
- Point 5: shared local observation timer, preserve intervals/limits/status and async/modal identity semantics. No UI redesign or OAuth/pairing protocol coupling.
- Point 3: user "okay 3 is settled ... all points settled now" after approving backend-neutral cleanup in jido_chat_whatsapp and ZAQ; no changes to jido_chat or Amarula. File, custom, prebuilt and Split storage supported with existing resolution semantics. Optional package extension, not new shared behaviour callback. Existing saved binding, no provisioning/connection creation. Running listener uses logout; absent listener uses cleanup. Host prevents concurrent startup/writes through disable commit and stop. Partial failure returns error and explicit retry; no false atomic rollback. Missing required storage is not success. Retain credential association, clear only selected account, relink after successful disable, normal shutdown preserves credentials. No guarantee of remote WhatsApp unlink without a live connection.

Authorization: current request authorizes Beadwork planning only. No code edits, application tests, gh, external messages, commit/push/merge or package publication in this planning turn. Future agents need implementation instruction and separate Git/publication authorization; prepare concrete reviewable package change before requesting publication. Reuse existing issues zaq-0l7.21 (start/stop serialization), zaq-0l7.7 (human UX gate), zaq-0l7.8 (consolidated E2E), zaq-0l7.24.6 (final validation); preserve their historical dependencies and append this iteration's scope, not duplicate them.

Required execution policies: AGENTS.md in each affected repository; ZAQ docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md and relevant domain guides. Every child contains functional scope, test-first scenarios, branches, mocking, documentation and reuse contract. State unknown contradictions in the issue; do not silently select a new security/product/architecture contract. Routine implementation details may be resolved within these invariants with source evidence.

Completion requires all child contracts and reused prerequisites, authorized published adapter pin, actual human UX approval before new E2E authoring, completed consolidated E2E, review approval, dedicated coverage phase, and reused final mix precommit gate before final acceptance. Existing assertions remain except specifically approved changes. Plan approval is not feature UX approval. Numerical coverage follows the dedicated skill, not arbitrary thresholds in implementation. No live WhatsApp or real sends authorized.

Action reuse assessment: implementation assessments live per operation in child issues and are rechecked before edits. Core decisions: reuse canonical Connect persistence; extend ConnectorLifecycle with explicit enable Action before BO integration; extend local polling helper; package/transport offline cleanup reuses Amarula.Storage.clear and Storage.Split behind trusted adapter boundary. No new registry or workflow exposure.
